accepted.s: The Information Fusion Centre–Indian Ocean Region (IFC-IOR) was set up by the Indian Navy at which place in 2018?
accepted.x: The IFC-IOR was established by the Indian Navy at Gurugram in 2018.
accepted.tq: Use the location cue to distinguish the fusion centre from naval operational headquarters.
accepted.sec: Maritime domain awareness - IFC-IOR, coastal radars, ENC in AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The primary function of the IFC-IOR is to share which of the following with partner countries?
o: Naval personnel records and recruitment data
Satellite launch schedules and orbital data
accepted.x: The IFC-IOR facilitates the sharing of white-shipping and maritime-security information with partner countries.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its specific information-sharing function.
accepted.sec: Maritime domain awareness - IFC-IOR, coastal radars, ENC in AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India's coastal surveillance network:
1. It consists of 84 radar stations of the Indian Coast Guard.
2. It was set up after the 26/11 attacks.
3. It forms part of the coastal surveillance network.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Indian Coast Guard's 84 radar stations form a coastal surveillance network established after 26/11.
accepted.tq: Combine the number, institutional agency and cause without importing unrelated radar facts.
accepted.sec: Maritime domain awareness - IFC-IOR, coastal radars, ENC in AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The headquarters of the Eastern Naval Command is located at:
accepted.x: The Eastern Naval Command has its headquarters at Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Test the headquarters-location pair directly.
accepted.sec: Maritime domain awareness - IFC-IOR, coastal radars, ENC in AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: INS Dega is associated with which of the following?
o: A naval air station of the Eastern Naval Command
A coastal radar station of the Western Naval Command
accepted.x: INS Dega is the naval air station of the Eastern Naval Command.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between a naval air station, command headquarters and submarine base.
accepted.sec: Maritime domain awareness - IFC-IOR, coastal radars, ENC in AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The new submarine base mentioned in connection with the Eastern Naval Command is being built at:
accepted.x: A new submarine base is being built at Rambilli.
accepted.tq: Use the exact location rather than the better-known naval bases as distractors.
accepted.sec: Maritime domain awareness - IFC-IOR, coastal radars, ENC in AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The SAGAR and MAHASAGAR visions are associated with guiding India's:
accepted.x: The SAGAR and MAHASAGAR visions guide India's maritime and naval capabilities.
accepted.tq: Apply the vision to the domain with which it is institutionally associated.
accepted.sec: Maritime domain awareness - IFC-IOR, coastal radars, ENC in AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Arjun Mk-1A—Russia, licence-built at HVF Avadi
accepted.x: Arjun Mk-1A was developed by DRDO through CVRDE, Chennai.
accepted.tq: Identify the developer-origin pair rather than the production location of another tank.

accepted.s: The T-90 Bhishma is best described as a tank of which origin and production arrangement?
o: Russian origin and licence-built at HVF Avadi
Indigenous design by DRDO and built only at Chennai
French origin and assembled by HAL
Israeli origin and produced by NIBE
accepted.x: The T-90 Bhishma is of Russian origin and is licence-built at the Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi.
accepted.tq: Separate origin from Indian licence production.

accepted.s: The Zorawar is a light tank developed by:
o: Ordnance Factory Board with Russia for plains
HAL with Bharat Forge for desert warfare
DRDO with Larsen & Toubro for high-altitude areas
DRDO with Israel for naval operations
accepted.x: The Zorawar light tank is being developed by DRDO with L&T for high-altitude areas.
accepted.tq: Use the developer-purpose-location relationship as the discriminator.

accepted.s: ATAGS is associated with which of the following descriptions?
o: A multi-barrel rocket launcher developed only by HAL
An automated air-defence network developed by the Navy
A 155 mm towed gun developed by DRDO's ARDE with Indian industry
A universal rocket launcher developed by Russia
accepted.x: ATAGS is a 155 mm towed gun developed by DRDO's ARDE with Indian industry.
accepted.tq: Distinguish artillery-gun systems from rocket launchers and command networks.

accepted.s: Dhanush is correctly described as:
o: A 155 mm gun based on the Bofors design, associated with the Ordnance Factory Board at Jabalpur
A 155 mm gun based on the Bofors design, developed by HAL at Bengaluru
A Russian tank licence-built at Avadi
A 300 km universal rocket launcher made by NIBE
accepted.x: Dhanush is a 155 mm gun based on the Bofors design and was associated with the Ordnance Factory Board at Jabalpur.
accepted.tq: Check both the weapon description and the developer-origin pair.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Suryastra—NIBE with Israel; universal rocket launcher; 300 km
Suryastra—DRDO with Russia; 155 mm towed gun; 120 km
Suryastra—HAL with France; light combat helicopter; 300 km
Suryastra—BEL with the Army; air-defence network; 120 km
accepted.x: Suryastra is a universal rocket launcher developed by NIBE with Israel, with a stated range of 300 km.
accepted.tq: Use the three-part match: developer, weapon type and range.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding LCA Tejas is correct?
o: It is a high-altitude attack helicopter built by DRDO.
It is a light, multirole fourth-generation fighter developed by ADA with DRDO and built by HAL.
It is a third-generation main battle tank developed by CVRDE.
It is a multi-barrel rocket launcher produced by ARDE.
accepted.x: LCA Tejas is a light, multirole fourth-generation fighter developed by ADA with DRDO and built by HAL.
accepted.tq: Separate the platform type, generation and developer from nearby defence systems.

accepted.s: Which feature is specifically associated with Tejas?
o: It was India's first automated air-defence network
It was India's first licence-built Russian tank
It was India's first 300 km universal rocket launcher
It was India's first indigenous fly-by-wire aircraft
accepted.x: Tejas is identified as India's first indigenous fly-by-wire aircraft.
accepted.tq: Test the distinctive technological feature rather than the broad platform category.

accepted.s: Approximately what proportion of the Tejas airframe is made of carbon-fibre composites?
accepted.x: Carbon-fibre composites constitute approximately 45% of the Tejas airframe.
accepted.tq: Use the central numerical value among plausible material-content figures.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the Tejas development sequence?
accepted.x: The sequence given is Tejas Mk-1, followed by Mk-1A, and then Mk-2, which remains under development.
accepted.tq: Follow the model-designation sequence from the base variant to later variants.

accepted.s: Which one of the following features is associated with the Tejas Mk-1A?
o: Uttam AESA radar, an electronic-warfare suite and air-to-air refuelling
GE F414 engine and canards only
accepted.x: The Mk-1A includes the Uttam AESA radar, an EW suite and air-to-air refuelling capability.
accepted.tq: Discriminate the Mk-1A features from the Mk-2 features.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Tejas Mk-2:
1. It is associated with a GE F414 engine.
2. It includes canards.
3. It is under development.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Tejas Mk-2 is under development and is associated with a GE F414 engine and canards.
accepted.tq: Separate the later-variant features from the Mk-1A equipment package.

accepted.s: On 25 September 2025, an order was placed with HAL for how many LCA Mk1A aircraft?
accepted.x: An order for 97 LCA Mk1A aircraft was placed with HAL on 25 September 2025.
accepted.tq: Test the exact procurement quantity using nearby component figures as distractors.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the value and delivery schedule of the LCA Mk1A order?
accepted.x: The 97-aircraft order was valued at ₹62,370 crore, with deliveries scheduled from 2027–28 onwards.
accepted.tq: Pair the procurement value with the correct delivery timeline.

accepted.s: The indigenous content specified for the LCA Mk1A order is:
accepted.x: The LCA Mk1A order is associated with more than 64% indigenous content.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact percentage threshold from the Tejas composite-content figure.

accepted.s: The maiden test of the Pinaka Long Range Guided Rocket LRGR-120 was conducted at ITR Chandipur on:
accepted.x: The maiden test of LRGR-120 took place at ITR Chandipur on 29 December 2025.
accepted.tq: Anchor the event to its exact date and test location.

accepted.s: The maximum range of the Pinaka LRGR-120 is:
accepted.x: The LRGR-120 has a maximum range of 120 km.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the rocket's range from the 300 km range of another launcher.

accepted.s: Radar cross-section refers to:
o: The number of radar operators in a control room
The frequency band used by a satellite
The actual physical area occupied by a radar station
How large a target appears to radar
accepted.x: Radar cross-section indicates how large or prominent a target appears to radar.
accepted.tq: Discriminate an apparent radar property from physical size and operating frequency.

accepted.s: Which combination can reduce the radar cross-section of a defence platform?
o: Unshielded metal surfaces and external weapon mounts only
Glossy paint, exposed weapons and sharp antennas
Shaping, radar-absorbent coatings and flush-mounted weapons
Increased engine noise, open weapon bays and larger surfaces
accepted.x: Radar cross-section can be reduced through shaping, radar-absorbent coatings and flush-mounted weapons.
accepted.tq: Identify the combination of design measures that reduces detectability.

accepted.s: The load-bearing stealth structures referred to in connection with stealth technology are made by:
accepted.x: ASL makes load-bearing stealth structures.
accepted.tq: Match the specialised laboratory with its defence-material capability.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: CL-20—among the most powerful non-nuclear explosives; synthesised by HEMRL Pune
CL-20—an oxygen-supply system developed by DEBEL
CL-20—a high-altitude herbal product developed by DIHAR
CL-20—a nuclear medicine product developed by INMAS
accepted.x: CL-20 is among the most powerful non-nuclear explosives and has been synthesised by HEMRL Pune.
accepted.tq: Match the explosive with its strength and synthesising laboratory.

accepted.s: HMX is also known as:
accepted.x: HMX is known as octogen and is a high-melting, powerful military explosive.
accepted.tq: Test the exact alternate name of the explosive.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes LLM-105?
o: An insensitive high explosive designed to be safer against accidental detonation
A pilotless target aircraft for weapon training
accepted.x: LLM-105 is an insensitive high explosive with greater safety against accidental detonation.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the material's safety property from unrelated defence products.

accepted.s: Rustom-II, also known as TAPAS-BH-201, belongs to which UAV class?
accepted.x: Rustom-II or TAPAS-BH-201 is a Medium Altitude Long Endurance UAV.
accepted.tq: Expand the acronym and match it with the correct UAV class.

accepted.s: TAPAS-BH-201 was flown in:
accepted.x: TAPAS-BH-201 was flown in November 2016.
accepted.tq: Use the year associated with the platform's first stated flight milestone.

accepted.s: Nishant is primarily a:
o: Pilotless target aircraft for weapon training
accepted.x: Nishant is a tactical UAV intended for battlefield reconnaissance.
accepted.tq: Distinguish reconnaissance, target-training and armed UAV roles.

accepted.s: Lakshya is best described as a:
o: Pilotless target aircraft for weapon training
Medium Altitude Long Endurance reconnaissance UAV
accepted.x: Lakshya is a pilotless target aircraft used for weapon training.
accepted.tq: Match the platform with its operational training role.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Ghatak—stealth UCAV with a flying-wing configuration
Ghatak—pilotless target aircraft for weapon training
accepted.x: Ghatak is a stealth UCAV with a flying-wing configuration; its demonstrator is a high-speed flying-wing UAV.
accepted.tq: Use configuration and role together to distinguish the UCAV from other UAV classes.

accepted.s: Archer-NG is classified as an:
accepted.x: Archer-NG is an armed Medium Altitude Long Endurance UAV.
accepted.tq: Separate the armed MALE category from reconnaissance and target UAV categories.

accepted.s: The ULPGM-V3 trials conducted near Kurnool relate to a UAV-launched precision-guided missile tested in which modes?
accepted.x: ULPGM-V3 underwent final development trials in air-to-ground and air-to-air modes near Kurnool.
accepted.tq: Identify the two operational modes from the missile's trial description.

accepted.s: Lukoskin is used as a:
o: Polyherbal ointment for leucoderma or vitiligo
accepted.x: Lukoskin is a polyherbal ointment used for leucoderma, also called vitiligo.
accepted.tq: Match the product with its specific medical use.

accepted.s: Bio-toilets based on bio-digesters are used for:
o: Waste treatment in high-altitude areas and have been adopted by the Railways
Detecting chemical agents in NBC warfare
accepted.x: Bio-toilets treat waste in high-altitude environments and have been adopted by the Railways.
accepted.tq: Connect the product with both its use and adoption context.

accepted.s: 2-DG, developed in 2021, is best described as a:
o: Oral anti-COVID drug developed by INMAS with Dr Reddy's
Bio-digester developed by DRDE for Railways
High-altitude oxygen system developed by DIPAS
accepted.x: 2-DG, or 2-deoxy-D-glucose, is an oral anti-COVID drug developed by INMAS with Dr Reddy's in 2021.
accepted.tq: Match the product, year, use and collaborating organisations.

accepted.x: DIPAS is associated with high-altitude physiology products such as the Bukhari space heater, oxygenated solar shelter and Cognobar. A chemical agent monitor is associated with DRDE.

accepted.s: DRDE Gwalior is primarily associated with:
accepted.x: DRDE Gwalior works in NBC defence and is associated with NBC haversacks, chemical-agent monitors and decontamination kits.
accepted.tq: Match the laboratory with its specialised defence domain.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is associated with INMAS?
o: Nuclear medicine and the bike ambulance
Bukhari space heaters and solar shelters
accepted.x: INMAS deals with nuclear medicine and is associated with the bike ambulance.
accepted.tq: Use laboratory specialisation to eliminate products of DIPAS, DRDE and DIHAR.

accepted.s: DIHAR, headquartered at Leh, is associated with:
accepted.x: DIHAR is the Defence Institute of High Altitude Research at Leh and works on high-altitude agriculture and herbal products.
accepted.tq: Match the institute's location, full domain and outputs.
